Model.WebIntro:
The listing below includes all legislation received by Municipal Code since the last update (printed or electronic) to the Long Beach Municipal Code. These ordinances have been adopted, but not yet codified.

Emergency Ordinances are marked as (Emerg). What is an Emergency Ordinance?

You may also view the ordinances with their related legislative history and staff reports on the legislative system at http://longbeach.legistar.com/Legislation.aspx

Note: The pdf versions of the ordinances are best viewed by downloading the ordinance by clicking on the "Download" button which will launch Adobe Acrobat. If you do not have Adobe Acrobat, you can download the free reader from Adobe.
